records.name: Labelhai Beteiligung
records.biography_en: Only takes a modest percentage of everything that might happen. His HyperNorm record promises ownership of every possible future success. A dissonant card asks why the missing wedge is called a modest share. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beteiligung betrifft nur das eventuell noch Kommende.

variant_notes.note_en: Only takes a modest percentage of everything that might happen.

records.name: Sternchen Einmalnoch
records.biography_en: Would like the next song to introduce her to the first one's audience. Her HyperNorm medal identifies her so completely that nobody hears the next song. A dissonant card asks her to sing something unfinished. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Gelegenheit wird am ersten Erfolg gemessen.

variant_notes.note_en: Would like the next song to introduce her to the first one's audience.

records.name: Sänger Tonrichtig
records.biography_en: Hits every approved note without finding where he left the feeling. His dial tunes HyperNorm feeling to the approved interval. A dissonant card holds one wavering note long enough for someone to recognize it. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Ton ist richtig. Die Empfindung wird nachgeregelt.

variant_notes.note_en: Hits every approved note without finding where he left the feeling.

records.name: Fan Doppelsigniert
records.biography_en: Is perfectly happy to be nobody important in two separate queues. His HyperNorm wristbands admit him to two versions of the same wait. A dissonant card asks what he loves when nobody famous is looking. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bedeutungslosigkeit verfügt bereits über zwei Zugangsberechtigungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Is perfectly happy to be nobody important in two separate queues.

records.name: Roadie Tragfähig
records.biography_en: Carries the sound of everybody else's freedom. Her amplifier carries every HyperNorm demand for effortless expression. A dissonant card stays behind to help her lift it. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Freiheit der anderen wurde transportgerecht verpackt.

variant_notes.note_en: Carries the sound of everybody else's freedom.

records.name: Anwalt Kleingedruckt
records.biography_en: Can make an excellent opportunity fit inside a remarkably small exception. His magnifier finds the HyperNorm exception that swallows the promise. A dissonant card reads the sentence aloud at an inconveniently ordinary speed. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gelegenheit passt vollständig in ihren Ausschluss.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make an excellent opportunity fit inside a remarkably small exception.
